thig6.2:1.1: Overwhelmed with grief for my son—
thig6.2:1.2:
naked, demented,
my hair disheveled
my mind deranged—
thig6.2:2.1:
living along the side of the road,
in cemeteries & heaps of trash,
thig6.2:3.1:
Then I saw
the One Well-Gone,
thig6.2:3.2: gone to the city of Mithilā:
thig6.2:3.4:
Self-Awakened,
with nothing to fear
from anything, anywhere.
thig6.2:4.2:
paying him homage,
I sat myself down.
thig6.2:4.4:
Gotama, from sympathy
taught me the Dhamma.
thig6.2:5.3: Applying myself to the Teacher’s words,
thig6.2:5.4: I realized the state of auspicious bliss.
thig6.2:6.1: All griefs have been cut off,
thig6.2:6.4:
from which griefs
come into play.
